title: Sell digital downloads you design yourself on Etsy
audience: Designers and hobbyists who can make their own files, such as planners or templates, and want to sell them.
summary: Etsy lets sellers list digital files, as long as the seller made or designed them. AI tools can help you brainstorm, but this Etsy page does not address AI, so check Etsy's current rules first. No income figure is given.
workflow_steps: Pick a digital product you can design yourself, since Etsy says digital items must be made and/or designed by the seller
Check Etsy's current rules on AI-assisted creation before you start; this help page does not cover them
Create the file or files: up to five per listing, each up to 20MB, in a supported type such as PDF, PNG, JPEG, ZIP or EPUB
Create the listing, choose Digital files, and pick instant download or made-to-order
Name your files carefully: buyers see the same names and you cannot edit them after upload
Optionally add a note for buyers, which they see on their Downloads page after purchase
tools_and_prompts: A design tool for the final file
An AI assistant for ideas, with a prompt such as: suggest ten layout ideas for a [PRODUCT]; I will design the final file myself

income.basis: No income figure appears in the source; it covers rules, not earnings. Results vary.

time_to_first_result: Varies; not stated in the source
risks: Etsy requires digital items to be made and/or designed by you
This help page does not state Etsy's AI policy, so check the current rules before listing
Cancelling an order is the only way to revoke a buyer's access to a file after purchase
Sales are not guaranteed and may be zero
